soal_05_stimulus_01.png.description: Coordinate axes: vertical axis labeled "Y" (arrow up), horizontal axis labeled "X" (arrow right); no origin label is printed. Tick marks with printed numbers: on the Y-axis "4" (upper) and "2" (lower); on the X-axis "4" and "6". Two straight lines are drawn. Line 1 passes through the Y-axis tick labeled 4 and the X-axis tick labeled 4 and extends beyond both axes. Line 2 passes through the Y-axis tick labeled 2 and the X-axis tick labeled 6 and extends beyond both axes. The two lines cross at one point. Roman-numeral region labels are printed: "I" near the origin, below both lines; "II" just right of the Y-axis between the two lines (between the Y-axis ticks 2 and 4); "III" just above the point where the two lines cross; "IV" just above the X-axis between the ticks 4 and 6; "V" left of the Y-axis between the extensions of the two lines. No shading.

soal_10_stimulus_01.png.description: Diagram of concentric circles with fruit pieces. Four concentric circles are drawn; the outermost is large and empty. Inside it, three smaller concentric circles delimit three zones. Innermost zone: 4 light-green melon wedges arranged around the centre like a four-petal cross. Middle ring: 8 red watermelon wedges (triangular slices with a green rind) spaced around the ring. Outer ring: 16 yellow pineapple rings spaced around the ring. soal_14_prompt_01.png.description: Line drawing of a closed four-sided outline (drawn as a rectangle) with a small hatched (diagonal-lined) square at each of its four inner corners. A vertical dimension line with end ticks runs along the left side with the rotated text "30 cm". Each of the four sides has a short perpendicular tick mark at its midpoint. Under the bottom-left hatched corner square and under the bottom-right hatched corner square there is a short horizontal dimension segment with end ticks, each labeled "x".

soal_15_stimulus_01.png.description: Photograph of a triangular (A-frame) shelf unit with black marble-patterned sides and white shelves, against a light wall (framed city-skyline picture at left; objects on the shelves such as a camera, an animal figurine, books, a tower statuette, a plant). Yellow capital letters A to I and orange dashed lines are overlaid. A is at the apex. An orange dashed slanted line runs from A down the left leg through B, D and F to H (bottom-left). An orange dashed vertical line runs from A straight down through C, E and G to I (bottom). Short orange dashed horizontal segments connect B to C (top shelf level), D to E (second shelf level) and F to G (third shelf level). An orange dashed horizontal line along the bottom connects H to I. Letter positions: B on the left leg and C right of the vertical line at the top shelf; D and E at the second shelf; F and G at the third shelf; H at the bottom-left; I at the bottom on the vertical line. No numbers or measurements are printed.

Middle: a taller pipe made of two segments joined by one wider connector band located around the middle of the pipe; arrow labeled "795 cm" spanning the pipe from top to bottom. Right: the tallest pipe made of three segments joined by two wider connector bands (one in the upper part, one in the lower part); arrow labeled "1190 cm" spanning the pipe from top to bottom.

A large red curved arrow points from the photograph to the right panel. Right panel: a 3D cut-away diagram of a bridge deck resting on a concrete pier, with two labels "GIRDER" (each with a leader line pointing to a girder beam beneath the deck). A small car icon is on the deck. Red graphics: a downward arrow above the deck at the car; a red line along the deck lane ending in a small downward arrow at the girder side; and three vertical red double-headed (up and down) arrows beside the pier. No numbers are printed.
